title: Edge-case Review — agent verdict input
description: Written by the existing-app test agent to .github/.pipeline-context/verify/<id>.edgecase.verdict.json after reading <id>.edgecase.facts.md, then consumed by scripts/render-edgecase.js. Answers: does the change survive boundary/error conditions and inputs the plan didn't explicitly cover?

attempted_vectors.description: Every concrete edge case actually reasoned through against the NEW code — a boundary value, a null/empty input, an unexpected parameter combination — not a restatement of the story.

vector.description: What was tried, concretely, e.g. 'updateEmployee with the caller's own current email unchanged'.

gaps_found.description: Required non-empty when verdict is GAPS_FOUND; omit or leave empty otherwise.
